title: History & Civics
description: History and Civics (H.C.G. Paper 1) for ICSE Examination Year 2027: the Union Government, the national movement, the contemporary world and the international order.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Regulations and Syllabuses, Examination Year 2027 - History and Civics (H.C.G. Paper 1); corroborated by the Educart and Jagran Josh 2026-27 syllabus reproductions (cisce.org returns 403 to automated readers, so the reproduced documents were used).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Section A is Civics (Union Legislature, Union Executive, Judiciary) and Section B is History (national movement 1857-1917, mass phase 1915-1947, the contemporary world). No textbook is named by the syllabus; an 80-mark 2-hour paper with 20 marks internal assessment.

sections.title: Civics
sections.description: The Union Government: Parliament, the Executive and the Judiciary.

chapters.title: The Union Legislature
chapters.blurb: Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha composition, sessions, procedures, money bills, the Speaker and Parliament's powers.

chapters.title: The Union Executive
chapters.blurb: President, Vice-President, Prime Minister and Council of Ministers: election, tenure, powers and responsibility.

chapters.title: The Judiciary
chapters.blurb: Supreme Court and High Courts, jurisdiction, judicial review, writs, subordinate courts and Lok Adalats.

sections.title: History
sections.description: From the Revolt of 1857 to the making of the present world.

chapters.title: The First War of Independence, 1857
chapters.blurb: Political, socio-religious, economic and military causes of the revolt and its consequences for British rule.

chapters.title: The Growth of Nationalism and the Early Nationalists
chapters.blurb: Economic exploitation, repressive policies, reform movements and the Press, the founding of the Congress and the Moderates.

chapters.title: The Assertive Nationalists and the Partition of Bengal
chapters.blurb: Partition of Bengal, the Surat Split, Tilak, Pal and Lajpat Rai, the Muslim League and the Lucknow Pact.

chapters.title: Mahatma Gandhi and the Mass Phase
chapters.blurb: Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience and Quit India: causes, programmes, suspension and impact.

chapters.title: Forward Bloc, INA and Independence and Partition
chapters.blurb: Subhas Chandra Bose, the Indian National Army, the Cabinet Mission, the Mountbatten Plan and the Independence Act.

chapters.title: The First World War and the Rise of Dictatorships
chapters.blurb: Causes of the war, the Treaty of Versailles, the League of Nations, Fascism in Italy and Nazism in Germany.

chapters.title: The Second World War
chapters.blurb: Causes from Versailles to the invasion of Poland, the world war years and its consequences including the Cold War.

chapters.title: The United Nations and Non-Alignment
chapters.blurb: UN objectives and organs, its agencies, the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the Non-Aligned Movement.
